component.name: DeepSeek Harness
component.summary: Agentic coding assistant with a browser UI

description.p: DeepSeek Harness is an agentic coding assistant. It reads and edits files, runs shell commands, searches code, and drives subagents in your working directory, and it serves a browser interface for interactive sessions.
This package bundles the upstream self-contained runtime, so it needs no system Node.js and no package-manager install step. Sessions are stored under DSH_HOME (default ~/.dsh).
